- Ten-word bullets capturing overt, obvious, benign-sounding main points.

## HIDDEN MESSAGE
- Ten-word bullets capturing true, hidden, cynical, political messages.

## SUPPORTING ARGUMENTS and QUOTES
- Bulleted list of justifications using logic, argument, direct quotes supporting the hidden message.

## DESIRED AUDIENCE ACTION
- Set of 10, ten-word bullets of real-world politically oriented actions the speaker wants after absorbing the hidden message.

## CYNICAL ANALYSIS
- One sentence
